title: Root projection equation with shared categorical interfaces
statement: For categories C,D, functors R,E:C→D, a natural transformation pi:R→E, objects I,J of C and M of D, a:M→R(I), b:I→J, and d:M→E(J), rootProjectionEquation(R,E,pi,a,b,d) means a≫pi(I)≫E(b)=d. This is an irreducible wrapper for the displayed equation; it shares each category structure explicitly to prevent repeated expansion in the concrete derived sheaf categories.

def rootProjectionEquation
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (R E : C ⥤ D) (pi : R ⟶ E) {I J : C} {M : D}
    (a : M ⟶ R.obj I) (b : I ⟶ J) (d : M ⟶ E.obj J) : Prop
